mentions.name: Evidentia
mentions.description: Platform for scientific knowledge that never gets published, such as negative results, failed replications, and protocol details. Scientists share the details papers omit, including failed antibodies, critical protocol tweaks, and replication attempts, and AI plus a graph database structures it into queryable data. Contributors get DOIs so the work counts as real academic credit. The project has been in beta testing for two weeks and is opening a waitlist.
mentions.problem: Science's most valuable output never gets published: negative results, failed replications, and protocol details vanish into the file drawer, making the public body of knowledge slow and often wrong. 70% of researchers can't reproduce published findings, only 6 of 53 landmark cancer studies replicated, and industry wastes $28B annually re-validating work that doesn't hold up.
mentions.audience: Scientists sharing the unpublished experimental details, protocol tweaks, and replication attempts that papers omit
mentions.source_excerpt: We're building a platform to capture what gets lost. Scientists share the details papers omit: failed antibodies, critical protocol tweaks, replication attempts. AI + a graph DB structures it into queryable data. Contributors get DOIs so it counts as real academic credit.
